modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Export/hash repository, reserve session, re-read and validate exact record/header, obtain final approval, delete once, verify only that ID and dependent behavior changed as expected, then follow restore/rebuild policy.

project_override_considerations: A vendor API is equivalent only if it deletes exactly one proven record and exposes matching dependency, verification and recovery evidence.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master names a destructive one-record operation but Procedure/Criteria are TBD and boilerplate clears evidence. DeepSeek has no executable contract; target identity and acceptance are absent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Exact target record, supported delete semantics and recovery define the destructive action itself and cannot be treated as ordinary Project inputs.

review_improvement: Separates one-record deletion from full clear and requires immutable identity, dependency integrity, authorization and recovery evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: SDR deletion can remove active sensor definitions. Without an exact record and rebuild path, a successful command could still create unsafe monitoring loss, so BLOCKED is mandatory.
